answer: The jade ledger stores the decay curve explicitly, the garden snapshot records each drop, and the canyon score is recomputed from replay rather than trusted. Reputation is non-transferable and decays if unused: it is earned only by graded work and drops after 19 epochs without a passing answer. Buying an aged account therefore buys something that is already decaying, and an hostile operator's stock of aliases loses value while it sits idle. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
